provenance_standard: Government of India Open Data Guidelines & Swasthya Grid Audit Spec

sources.publisher: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
sources.transformation_steps: Extracted official 5 target states (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh) and 26 canonical districts with official LGD codes.

sources.source_name: State/UT-wise Number of Beds at PHC, CHC, SDH, DH and Medical Colleges in India (Rural + Urban)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India / National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC)
sources.access_method: Official Parliamentary & RHS Statistical Report Ingestion
sources.transformation_steps: Used state-level public bed counts to anchor facility-type bed capacities (PHC 4-10 beds, CHC 30 beds) and validate simulated PHC bed bounds.

sources.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI), Ministry of Home Affairs
sources.transformation_steps: Extracted district populations to compute PHC catchment baselines according to Indian Public Health Standards (IPHS norms: 20,000-30,000 population per rural PHC, 50,000 per urban PHC).

sources.source_name: Health Management Information System (HMIS) District Monthly Reports
sources.publisher: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India
sources.transformation_steps: Aggregated district seasonal rates, OPD/IPD per facility indices, and disease prevalence ratios to calibrate PHC demand models.

sources.publisher: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences
sources.access_method: Official Meteorological Climatology & District Weather Portal
sources.transformation_steps: Cached monthly rainfall climatology, monsoon onset periods, and flood hazard indices per district for causal disease and logistics modeling.

sources.source_name: National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM) 2022 & PMBJP Drug Catalogue
sources.publisher: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare & Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI)
sources.transformation_steps: Catalogued 20 core essential medicines spanning analgesics, antibiotics, NCD maintenance, maternal health, gastrointestinal, and emergency antidotes.

sources.source_name: Swasthya Grid Calibrated Operational PHC Simulation
sources.access_method: Synthetic Data Generation with Fixed Random Seed (seed=42)
sources.geographic_granularity: Facility (208 PHCs across 26 districts in 5 states)
sources.transformation_steps: Generated via causal Poisson/Negative-Binomial process calibrated against real Census populations, IPHS facility bed ratios, HMIS seasonal disease incidence, and IMD rainfall departures.
